injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.comment: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Paul George
injuries.comment: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.comment: Brown (illness) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.comment: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Brandon Miller
injuries.comment: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Dailyn Swain
injuries.comment: Swain (back) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.comment: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.comment: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injuries.name: Max Christie
injuries.comment: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.

injuries.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
injuries.comment: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.comment: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Ugonna Onyenso
injuries.comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.comment: Bassey is probable for Friday's game against the Spurs due to left toe soreness.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.comment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.comment: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Quentin Grimes
injuries.comment: Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.comment: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Luka Doncic
injuries.comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine," per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Collin Sexton
injuries.comment: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.comment: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.comment: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.comment: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Klay Thompson
injuries.comment: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Pelle Larsson
injuries.comment: Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.comment: McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.comment: Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.comment: Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Ajay Mitchell
injuries.comment: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.comment: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.comment: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Drew Timme
injuries.comment: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.comment: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.comment: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Devin Vassell
injuries.comment: Vassell is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left adductor tightness.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.comment: Fox is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left hip soreness.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
injuries.comment: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
injuries.comment: Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.comment: Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.comment: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Bub Carrington
injuries.comment: Carrington (chest) has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
